data.text: When you ask Claude to run tasks in parallel, it starts a nested session for each one. Each reports its result back into your main session when it's done, so the main thread stays readable. https://t.co/6gxVlCT1e4

It's now much easier to pick up where you left off. The new session screen keeps your recent folders one click away. 

You can also save a setup as an environment, like a few folders, an SSH host or the cloud, and start sessions there, with the option of a worktree per folder. https://t.co/kybTW1YVdX

We've been working hard on making the Claude Code desktop app great for running lots of sessions side by side. 

It's now much quicker to start sessions, easier to split work across a few, and you can always see what each of them is doing. Here’s what's new: https://t.co/iF1WuEueMB

Spans follow the OpenTelemetry gen_ai conventions. By default they carry metadata like duration, status, token counts, model, and tool names.

Switch a destination to "full content" to also export prompts, responses, tool inputs, and tool results.
Now in public beta, Claude Platform can send OpenTelemetry traces from the Messages API, Claude Managed Agents, and the Claude SDKs to your observability stack. https://t.co/gXmi5xlkfO
